question: How do 'guess the song from a short clip' games work (audio source, licensing, UX), what do players praise and resent about them, what do they pay for, and how could Trubbo (voice-first quiz, competitor Honk! Road Trip Quiz ships 'Name That Song' with 10 s clips) add it?
keywords: same songs?|songs? repeat|repeat\w* songs?|more songs|new songs

codebook.clip_length_part: about clip length or which part plays (too short/long, not the recognisable part, starts mid-song, fades out, wants intro vs chorus)
codebook.song_selection_narrow: song library too small, too pop/US-centric, missing big artists or genres, wrong era in a decade playlist
codebook.songs_repeat: same songs repeat, content runs out, wants new songs added
codebook.requests_genre_playlist: asks for a specific genre, decade, artist, language or local music (put it in `theme`, e.g. '90s rock', 'German Schlager')
codebook.praises_variety_discovery: praises the variety of songs/playlists or discovering new music, nostalgia
codebook.answer_input_issue: problems with how you answer: spelling/typing strictness, voice recognition misses, too few choices, 'close enough' wanted, timing too strict
codebook.audio_quality_wrong: bad audio: covers/soundalikes/robot voice instead of original, low quality, wrong song or wrong answer key, explicit lyrics
codebook.streaming_account_required: needs Spotify/Apple Music/premium account, login/connection fails, works only with a streaming subscription
codebook.social_party_play: about playing together (party, family, couple, car, friends, live shows), praise or problems
codebook.voice_hands_free: about voice play, Alexa/Siri/CarPlay, playing while driving or without looking at the screen
codebook.kids_family_safe: kid-friendliness, explicit content, ages, family use
codebook.daily_ritual: daily puzzle / streak / one-a-day habit, praise or complaints
codebook.paywall_subscription: complains about VIP/subscription, paywall, features moved behind payment, price too high, trial trap
codebook.happy_payer: paid (subscription, packs, playlists, premium) and says it was worth it, or willing to pay
codebook.ads: complains about ads or would pay to remove them
codebook.currency_grind: coins, tickets, keys, energy, lives economy, pay-to-win or rigged/bots
codebook.tech_bugs: crashes, lost progress, sync, sound not playing, connection problems
codebook.other: on topic (song guessing game experience) but none of the above (describe in `quote`)
